name: Green Passage Scheme

_eligibility_text: 1. The child must qualify as any one of the following: a) The child should be without biological/adoptive parents OR b) The child should have lost both parents OR c) The child should have lost a single bread-earning parent OR d) The child should be residing in a Child Care Institution, OR under foster care OR the care of a guardian OR any fit person/ surviving parent. 2. The annual income of the guardian/ fit person/ surviving parent (from all sources) does not exceed ₹ 8,00,000/-. 3. The student should be pursuing higher education in any Government or Non-Government Higher Education Institution (i.e., College & University). Here, "higher education" would mean general/professional/ technical education of at least 1 year's duration after Class-12.
